RESPOND.name: Respond
RESPOND.headline: Wait for the gut signal, then move
RESPOND.body: Your strategy is to respond to what comes to you — not start from nothing. When an opportunity, conversation, or invitation arrives, notice the reaction in your body: does something light up (yes), or does something pull back (no)? That's your sacral speaking. The gut voice is more accurate than the head. Over time you learn to read that signal more clearly.

INFORM.name: Inform
INFORM.headline: Move first, but give a heads-up
INFORM.body: As an initiator, you don't need permission to act — but the people affected need a heads-up. Before you execute, share briefly: "I'm going to work on X next week," or "I'm taking this decision today." That's not asking permission — it's bringing people into the loop so they're not surprised or feel skipped over.

WAIT_INVITATION.name: Wait for the Invitation
WAIT_INVITATION.headline: Your insight lands when it's asked for
WAIT_INVITATION.body: Your strategy is to wait for an invitation before sharing insight, energy, or help. If you give advice unasked, it usually bounces — the person becomes defensive or doesn't see why you're stepping in. But when you're invited, your advice becomes valuable. Wait for invitations on the big things: work, relationships, deep conversations, moves. Small daily exchanges don't need a formal invitation.

WAIT_LUNAR.name: Wait a Lunar Cycle
WAIT_LUNAR.headline: Before a big decision, give it 28 days
WAIT_LUNAR.body: As a Reflector, your energy is like water — it can shift drastically depending on environment and people. For major decisions (change job, end a relationship, buy a home), give yourself one lunar cycle (about 28 days) to feel the energy pattern from different angles. During that time, talk it over with people you trust — not to ask for answers, but to feel what reflects back.
